findings.description: T-21 rewind.py CLI help text does not mention the cross-month flight neighbour rewind rule flagged by ADR 2026-11-20. ADR tags it as deferred; defer as new IMPR item or accept a 1-line patch pre-merge. Operational mitigations (postgres_sink UPSERT on hk_flight, chronological-run convention) contain the hazard.

Drift check VAULT_PARTITIONED_TABLES tuple omits sat_state_observation per dispatch spec. 333M-row table drift would go undetected until next vault stage. qa/reconcile.py still catches post-build inconsistency. Log as IMPR to extend drift check when partitioning rolls to sat_state_observation.

fact_experiment_result ADR amendment (18 -> 19 cols with last_ym) not yet written to decisions.md. T-23 handoff documents this as orchestrator-homework (out of task scope). Pre-logged as architecture.md section 9.3 bullet 4.
